authority: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 section 20.4.51 defines BLOCK_CONTROL object size as the bit position before end handles, followed by NULL owner, optional xdictionary, user block handles, model space and paper space.
problem: AC1015/AC1018 deferred BLOCK_CONTROL wrote the handle tail inline before finishObject patched the object-size bit position. The resulting physical AC1018 field was 113 bits even though the actual handle stream began at bit 65; an independent ODA-produced AC1018 control uses bit 65.
change: Stage the deferred BLOCK_CONTROL handle tail for legacy AC1015/AC1018 before patching the data/handle boundary, as already done for other legacy table controls. Preserve existing AC1021 and AC1024+ control framing and extension flag behavior.
automated_validation: PASS: libdxfrw_dwg_block_control_handle_boundary independently parses the emitted frame, checks its CRC and declared handle boundary, and verifies the owner, extension, model and paper handle codes and targets for AC1015/1018/1024/1027/1032. Repeated block-control finalization is byte-idempotent. Existing libdxfrw_dwg_group_dictionary_controls and libdxfrw_dwg_header_writer_sealing cover six-version consumer readback, invalid-write rollback and retry.
independent_validation: LibreDWG 0.14 independently decodes production scratch files with AC1015 bit boundary 64 and AC1018 bit boundary 65, correct nonzero model and paper hard-owner handles, and a following LINE. AC1024/1027/1032 retain their previous physical model/paper handles and LINE.
